page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top left with page number at top right. Headings centred, with wavy ornaments below them. No marginal notes. Signature mark at the foot right.

main_text.head: LO SI, vel SE LO
main_text.p: Illum sibi: Lo si, vel Se lo eléffe: & Eléffelosi, vel Eléffeselo per compágno, illum sibi socium elegit.
main_text.head: LO VI, vel VE LO
main_text.p: Illum vobis: Lo vi, vel Ve lo raccomãdái: & Raccomandáiloui, vel Raccomandáiuelo, Illum vobis commendaui.
Illum illic, Lo vi, Ve lo vídi, & Vídiloui, vel Vídiuelo, illum illic vidi.
Illum illuc: Lo vi, Ve lo menái, Menáiloui, Menáiuelo, illum illuc duxi.
main_text.head: LO CI, vel CE LO
main_text.p: Illum nobis: Lo ci, vel ce lo raccomandò, & Raccomandólloci, vel Raccomandóccelo, illum nobis commendauit.
Illum illic: Lo ci, vel ce lo vídi, & Vídiloci, vel Vídicelo, illum illic vidi.
Illum illuc: Lo ci, vel ce lo menái, & Menáiloci, vel Menáicelo, Illum illuc duxi.

page.notes: Head ornaments are wavy rules, not text. Some words in the first heading and the second line of the first paragraph are set in mixed type and small capitals; the transcription follows the letters as seen. Final signature "k.iiii." is printed at the foot right.
